SubtitleProject.title: SubtitleProject
SubtitleProject.description: Represents a video subtitle generation and Bengali translation job with processing status and export metadata.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the project owner.

mimeType.description: Video MIME type (MP4, MOV, or MKV).

processingMode.description: Execution backend used for transcription and subtitle rendering.

remoteJobId.description: Optional remote FFmpeg backend job identifier.

localVideoUri.description: Optional local device content URI for video playback and export.

exportedMp4Path.description: Optional path or URI of the burned-in MP4 export.

cueCount.description: Total number of generated Bengali subtitle cues.

errorMessage.description: Optional failure description when status is failed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when project was created (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when project was last updated (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CuePage.title: CuePage
CuePage.description: Paginated batch of up to 100 synchronized English/Bengali subtitle cues for a project.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

cues.description: Bounded list of up to 100 subtitle cue objects.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: User-scoped subtitle processing projects and history.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}/cue.description: Paginated Bengali subtitle cues belonging to a project.
